report:
Feature: Head-on meeting: one train evades to the siding
Expected: log contains '<train> weicht aus' and later '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' for the same train
Observed failure: after Start the log only had 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet' within 1 s and nothing for 90 s; no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis'; both trains stood still (deadlock)
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later 'fährt weiter', then 'erreicht' for both trains
Observed failure: after Start only 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet'; no entries for 2 minutes; deadlock
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: markers never overlap or stand on the same track section
Observed failure: after Start both markers were drawn on top of each other near Weiche 2 in all three screenshots and did not move
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later '... 4', later '... 2' again
Observed failure: after Start only 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet'; no 'erreicht' entry within 150 s
Steps completed before failure: 7

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: '<train> wird kalibriert' followed by '<train> ist kalibriert' and a calibration-speed entry in the mock history
Observed failure: after Start only 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet' for 2 minutes; no calibration entries
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Operation can be started again after a Stop
Expected: after the second 'Start' at least one '<train> erreicht <stop>'
Observed failure: after the second Start only 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 1 wartet', 'Bahn 2 wartet'; no 'erreicht' entry in 60 s
Steps completed before failure: 13

Feature: Track graphic in the preview
Expected: whole layout visible incl. Weiche 2/3, spur, buffer stop and labels
Observed failure: the centred setup dialog covered the lower-right part of the graphic, so the siding end, Weiche 2/3, spur and buffer stop could not be verified

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
